input.rationale: We swept the document for MFN-style language ("no less favourable"/"no less favorable", "most favored nation", "more favorable", "comparable terms", "match") and found none. The FINANCIAL PROVISIONS article (upfront, milestones, royalty rates and reductions, Royalty Floor, U.S. profit/loss share) and the MANUFACTURING AND SUPPLY article contain only fixed, negotiated economics; supply pricing under Section 7.3 is set by a specified formula rather than by reference to terms granted to third parties. Sanofi therefore has no obligation to extend RevMed terms no less favourable than those given to any third party or to match third-party offers, which meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer). No redline is warranted; a Vendor-granted MFN would also be acceptable but none exists here.
